name: walk
note: Fully anisotropic: r.walk from the start over the DEM, r.walk from the end over the negated DEM, so the corridor is r.walk too. Two spreads per route. Routed 2026-10-13 at max_gap_scale 8, which matches r.cost's band area (standard 1.08x, IoU 0.77; the units ratio 12.4 gives 1.43x, because slack then also buys the climb). Cost from both ends equal on all 96. Lines vs steep_edge_control: 49 moved >50 m, 13 >250 m; length -4.9%, re-climb -39%, on >=30 +2.4%, <10 m of steep -7.2%, exp/km +6.1%. 1.88x the compute of r.cost (5.8 vs 3.1 s/route); a third of the r.walk spread time is negating the DEM. ArcGIS: tests.walk_report arcgis.
